construction.implementation_origin: Original implementation authored for this build

shared_schema.recommendation: action_id, title, finding_ids, score; journey steps additionally carry step, skills_before, skills_after
shared_schema.validation: Single validate entry point verifies strict input fields, types, uniqueness and references; recomputes canonical source extraction and canonical journey to validate stage outputs.
shared_schema.citation_offsets: Zero-based, end-exclusive Python Unicode character offsets into the identified passage, not byte offsets. Full passages are exact extractive findings.

cross_stage_handoffs: Validated input -> lexical passage retrieval -> validated research findings
Validated research findings exclusively establish supported action IDs, evidence IDs and scores for personalized journey recommendations
Validated output checks evidence integrity, canonical ranking and both prerequisite transitions

behavior.retrieval: Unique casefolded Unicode word overlap; positive matches only, descending score then source/passage ID; bounded by limit.
behavior.personalization: Sum of supporting finding scores plus count of exact interest/tag matches; descending score then action ID.
behavior.next_actions: All evidence-supported actions whose prerequisite skills are already satisfied.
behavior.journey: Exhaustive distinct two-action feasible pairs; maximize combined score, then first score, then lexicographic IDs. Step one grants skills available to step two.
behavior.unavailable: No supported actions yields insufficient_evidence; no feasible pair yields no_valid_two_step and empty steps. Successful processing still exits 0 with status ok.
behavior.blocked_now: Supported actions missing skills in the initial profile; these may become executable at step two.
behavior.skill_matching: Exact case-sensitive identifiers. An action cannot satisfy its own prerequisites with its own grants.
behavior.llm: No LLM step or injected callable is needed or included.

excluded: Semantic entailment verification of fixture action links

test_outcomes.cli_example: passed: one JSON object, status ok, journey ready with sort then compost
